# MSI Belgian third-year extension — SRC-0282

## Sources

- https://www.lasystems.be/en/msi-957-1xxxxe-073
- https://www.coolblue.be/nl/product/944001/msi-1-year-warranty-extension-service-for-notebooks.html

## Evidence

LASystems Belgium currently sells MSI service code `957-1XXXXE-073`, EAN `4711377081450`, for €162.62 including VAT and reports 12 units in EU warehouse stock. Coolblue Belgium's record for the identical manufacturer code explicitly says that it extends an MSI notebook from two to three warranty years and includes the Raider line. Coolblue's own listing is discontinued, but it corroborates regional/product-family applicability; LASystems supplies the live Belgian transaction.

This corrects, without reviving, the invalid German €119 price: that specific MSI Germany offer remains ineligible. The Belgian €162.62 product can be counted. As an extension of the normal hardware warranty, a fan or thermal-assembly failure arising under normal use falls within ordinary hardware-defect handling; accident, wear, battery and software exclusions remain. Registration and proof should be completed immediately after purchase and retained.
